_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Nondestructive Inspection (NDI) Procedures Technical Manual
summary: Provides format, content, and intended use requirements for a Nondestructive Inspection (NDI) Procedures Technical Manual applicable to aircraft structures, missiles, and major subsystems.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to any system acquisition that includes a requirement  for development of a Nondestructive Inspection (NDI) Procedures Technical Manual and is applicable to the entire system, for aircraft structures, missiles, and all major subsystems including airframe, engine, launch and recovery systems, mechanical subsystems and support equipment.

This DID contains the format, content and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content:
The NDI Procedures Technical Manual shall meet the general style and format requirements of MIL-STD-38784, General Style and Format Requirements for Technical Manuals.

(Copies of this document are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil/.)

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content:
The NDI technical manual detailed instructions shall follow the Work Package (WP) and Subordinate Work Package (SWP) content and format of MIL-DTL-87929, Manuals, Technical - Operation and Maintenance Instructions in Work Package Format (For USAF Equipment). Additional guidance for the NDI technical manual can be found in TO 33B-1-1/NAVAIR 01-1A-16-1/TM 1-1500-335-23, Nondestructive Inspection Methods, Basic Theory. and in AFLCMC/EZ Structures Bulletin, EZ-SB-15-002 Requirements for NDI Procedure Development, Validation, and Verification for Aircraft Structural Inspections During Operations and Support Phase.

(Copies of these documents are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil/; http://www.tinker.af.mil/Home/Technical-Orders/; and by request from Engineering.Standards@us.af.mil, respectively.)
